title: cystopteris elata
intro: Cystopteris elata, commonly known as the tall bladder fern, is a type of vascular plant belonging to the family Cystopteridaceae. It is native to East Asia and is often used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Cystopteris elata include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antioxidant properties, making it a valuable remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
